# Yield response

## Grain yield

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

t0 = lmer(yield ~ 1 + (1|year), data = sb_ipm2)
t1 = lmer(yield ~ time + (1|gen) + (1|year), data = sb_ipm2)
t2 = lmer(yield ~ time*gen + (1|year), data = sb_ipm2)
t3 = lmer(yield ~ time + (1|year/gen), data = sb_ipm2)

```

```{r}

AIC(t0,t1,t2,t3)
BIC(t0,t1,t2,t3)

```

```{r}

summary(t2)

```

```{r}
confint(t2)
```

```{r}

library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

emmeans::emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

emm = emmeans::emmeans(t2, ~ time*gen)

mm = emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "gen")#, by = "gen"

mm

confint(mm)


```
### Percent yield increase
```{r}

library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


emm <- emmeans(t2, ~ time * gen)


emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)  


control_level <- "_CHECK"


ctrl_means <- emm_df %>%
  filter(time == control_level) %>%
  select(gen, ctrl_mean = emmean)


mm <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "gen")


mm_ci <- confint(mm)           
mm_ci_df <- as.data.frame(mm_ci)


mm_ci_df <- mm_ci_df %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c("lhs", "rhs"), sep = "\\s-\\s") %>%
   dplyr::mutate(
    trt  = if_else(rhs == control_level, lhs, if_else(lhs == control_level, rhs, NA_character_)),
    ctrl = if_else(rhs == control_level, rhs, if_else(lhs == control_level, lhs, NA_character_)),
    D    = estimate
  ) %>%
   dplyr::filter(!is.na(ctrl)) %>% 
   dplyr::select(gen, trt, ctrl, D, SE, df, lower.CL, upper.CL)


mm_pct <- mm_ci_df %>%
  left_join(ctrl_means, by = "gen") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    D_percent         = 100 * D / ctrl_mean,
    lower.CL.percent  = 100 * lower.CL / ctrl_mean,  
    upper.CL.percent  = 100 * upper.CL / ctrl_mean
  )


mm_pct
```

# Profitability

## Functions

```{r}
G_crit <- function(price, cost){
  1000 * cost / price
}

net_return <- function(G, price, cost){
  G * price / 1000 - cost
}

#prob_positive <- function(G_hat, se_G, price, cost){
#  Gc <- G_crit(price, cost)
 # 1 - pnorm((Gc - G_hat) / se_G)
#}
gc()
```

```{r}
price <- c(300,400) #600,800,1000,1200,1400,1600     #300,400,500,600,700,800
cost  <- c(15,30,45,60,75,90,105) #100,200,300,400, 500,600,150,300,450, 600,750,900,1050

#price = seq(300, 600,length.out = 1000)
#cost = seq(15, 105,length.out = 1000)

#sev = seq(5, 60,length.out = 400)
#yld = seq(4000, 12000,length.out = 400)


scenarios <- expand.grid(price = price,
                         cost  = cost)

prob_positive <- function(G_hat, se_G, price, cost, n = 40000) {

  # força scalars
  price <- as.numeric(price)[1]
  cost  <- as.numeric(cost)[1]

  Gc <- G_crit(price, cost)

  # simulação correta
  G_sim <- rnorm(n, mean = G_hat, sd = se_G)

  z_sim <- (Gc - G_sim) / se_G

  mean(1 - pnorm(z_sim))
}

```

## Simulation

```{r}

library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

## 1) Emmeans por time*gen (como você já usa)
emm <- emmeans(t2, ~ time * gen)

## 2) Gerar contrastes vs. _CHECK por gen
##    (se você já tem 'mm' com revpairwise, dá para usar ele também; veja Observação A no fim)

mm_df <- as.data.frame(mm)

ct_check <- mm_df %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, " - _CHECK$")) %>%
  mutate(
    time   = str_replace(contrast, "\\s-\\s_CHECK$", ""),
    D_hat  = estimate,
    SE_hat = SE
  ) %>%
  select(gen, time, D_hat, SE_hat)

# ct_df tem colunas: gen, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value

## 3) Filtrar apenas "time - _CHECK" e extrair o rótulo de 'time'
ct_check <- ct_check %>% mutate(time = str_replace_all(time, "[()]", ""))

## 4) Função que aplica suas fórmulas em 'scenarios' para um (gen, time)
compute_metrics_for_row <- function(gen_i, time_i, D_i, SE_i, scenarios_df) {
  out <- scenarios_df
  out$gen  <- gen_i
  out$time <- time_i

  # usa suas funções exatamente como no seu exemplo
  out$Gcrit_hf <- with(out, G_crit(price, cost))
  out$Net_hf   <- with(out, net_return(D_i, price, cost))
  out$Prob_hf  <- with(out, prob_positive(D_i, SE_i, price, cost))

  out
}

## 5) Loop (map) sobre todas as linhas de 'ct_check'
results_all <- pmap_dfr(
  ct_check,
  function(gen, time, D_hat, SE_hat) {
    compute_metrics_for_row(gen, time, D_hat, SE_hat, scenarios)
  }
)

## 6) (Opcional) Resumo por gen × time
summary_gen_time <- results_all %>%
  group_by(gen, time,cost,price) %>%
  summarise(
    Net_hf_mean  = mean(Net_hf, na.rm = TRUE),
    Prob_hf_mean = mean(Prob_hf, na.rm = TRUE),
    Gcrit_mean   = mean(Gcrit_hf, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Visualizar os primeiros resultados
print(head(results_all))
print(summary_gen_time)


mean_profit = summary_gen_time %>% 
  filter(time != "B") %>%
  group_by(time,gen) %>% 
  summarise(
    P = round(mean(Prob_hf_mean),2),
    m = mean(Net_hf_mean),
  ) %>% 
  mutate(P = paste("p =",P))

```

# Probability

```{r}

# =============================================================
# MONTE CARLO HÍBRIDO: P(Δ > T) com incerteza em SE via χ²(df)
# =============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

cores_gen <- c(
  "CL111"    = "#2E8B57",
  "CLJ01"    = "#7FBF7B",
  "RT7301"   = "#D1BE91",
  "RT7302"   = "#A6764D",
  "RT7321FP" = "#6F3F1F"
)


# ---- Parâmetros globais ----
sack_kg    <- 50
sacks      <- 1:20
thresholds <- sacks * sack_kg
B          <- 40000
level      <- 0.95
set.seed(123)

# ---- Função HÍBRIDA: simula SE_b pela scaled-inverse-chi-square ----
mc_ci_row_normal_hibrido <- function(estimate, SE, df, thresholds, B, level = 0.95) {
  # 1) Incerteza do SE: SE_b^2 ~ (SE^2 * df) / χ²_df  => scaled-inverse-chi-square
  chi    <- rchisq(B, df = df)
  SE_b2  <- (SE^2 * df) / chi
  SE_b   <- sqrt(SE_b2)

  # 2) Incerteza da média do contraste: Δ_b ~ Normal(estimate, SE_b)
  Delta_b <- rnorm(B, mean = estimate, sd = SE_b)

  # 3) Para cada threshold, calcular probabilidade e intervalos
  results <- lapply(thresholds, function(Tk) {
    # Probabilidade condicional dada cada (Δ_b, SE_b):
    # p_b = 1 - Φ((Tk - Δ_b) / SE_b)
    p_b <- 1 - pnorm((Tk - Delta_b) / SE_b)

    alpha <- 1 - level
    tibble(
      threshold_kg  = Tk,
      # Ponto (analítico plug-in com SE fixo):
      prob_point    = 1 - pnorm((Tk - estimate) / SE),
      # ICs pelos quantis dos p_b (propagam incerteza de Δ e SE)
      prob_CI_lower = quantile(p_b, probs = alpha/2, names = FALSE),
      prob_CI_upper = quantile(p_b, probs = 1 - alpha/2, names = FALSE)
    )
  })

  bind_rows(results)
}

# =============================================================
# Dados do emmeans (contrastes) — seu exemplo
# =============================================================
emm <- tibble::tribble(
  ~genotype, ~contrast, ~estimate,  ~SE,  ~df,
  "CL111",   "B - _CHECK",             658.16,  214,   37,
  "CL111",   "(B+H) - _CHECK",         834.31,  241,   37,
  "CL111",   "H - _CHECK",             257.71,  241,   37,
  "CL111",   "PD7 - _CHECK",           796.88,  241,   37,
  "CL111",   "(PD7+B) - _CHECK",      1115.07,  241,   37,
  "CL111",   "(PD7+B+H) - _CHECK",     782.49,  241,   37,
  "CL111",   "(PD7+H) - _CHECK",       945.17,  241,   37,

  "CLJ01",   "B - _CHECK",             -72.19,  231,   37,
  "CLJ01",   "(B+H) - _CHECK",         223.90,  257,   37,
  "CLJ01",   "H - _CHECK",            -248.75,  257,   37,
  "CLJ01",   "PD7 - _CHECK",           240.30,  257,   37,
  "CLJ01",   "(PD7+B) - _CHECK",       378.21,  257,   37,
  "CLJ01",   "(PD7+B+H) - _CHECK",     710.88,  257,   37,
  "CLJ01",   "(PD7+H) - _CHECK",       373.36,  257,   37,

  "RT7301",  "B - _CHECK",             319.97,  363,   37,
  "RT7301",  "(B+H) - _CHECK",         459.80,  445,   37,
  "RT7301",  "H - _CHECK",              22.21,  445,   37,
  "RT7301",  "PD7 - _CHECK",           -18.92,  445,   37,
  "RT7301",  "(PD7+B) - _CHECK",       671.19,  445,   37,
  "RT7301",  "(PD7+B+H) - _CHECK",     945.09,  445,   37,
  "RT7301",  "(PD7+H) - _CHECK",       389.88,  445,   37,

  "RT7302",  "B - _CHECK",            1326.24,  445,   37,
  "RT7302",  "(B+H) - _CHECK",        1579.27,  445,   37,
  "RT7302",  "H - _CHECK",            1193.22,  445,   37,
  "RT7302",  "PD7 - _CHECK",          1003.49,  445,   37,
  "RT7302",  "(PD7+B) - _CHECK",      1211.87,  445,   37,
  "RT7302",  "(PD7+B+H) - _CHECK",    1303.99,  445,   37,
  "RT7302",  "(PD7+H) - _CHECK",      1052.85,  445,   37,

  "RT7321FP","B - _CHECK",             150.25,  445,   37,
  "RT7321FP","(B+H) - _CHECK",        -302.69,  445,   37,
  "RT7321FP","H - _CHECK",             359.72,  445,   37,
  "RT7321FP","PD7 - _CHECK",           367.40,  445,   37,
  "RT7321FP","(PD7+B) - _CHECK",       152.44,  445,   37,
  "RT7321FP","(PD7+B+H) - _CHECK",     218.25,  445,   37,
  "RT7321FP","(PD7+H) - _CHECK",       -12.06,  445,   37
)

# ---- Limpar o "time" (parte à esquerda do '- _CHECK')
emm <- emm %>%
  mutate(time = str_replace(contrast, "\\s*-\\s*_CHECK\\s*$", "")) %>%
  select(genotype, time, estimate, SE, df)

# ---- Rodar Monte Carlo linha-a-linha (versão híbrida)
out_hibrido <- emm %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mc = list(
      mc_ci_row_normal_hibrido(
        estimate   = estimate,
        SE         = SE,
        df         = df,
        thresholds = thresholds,
        B          = B,
        level      = level
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::unnest(mc) %>%
  mutate(
    sacks = threshold_kg / sack_kg
  )

# ---- Resultado final (híbrido)
out_hibrido%>%
  filter(time != "B") %>%
  ggplot(aes(threshold_kg, prob_point, group = genotype, colour = genotype)) +
  geom_smooth(se = F,size = 2)+
  #geom_line(size = 1.8) +
  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = prob_CI_lower, ymax = prob_CI_upper, fill = genotype),
   #           alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~time) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cores_gen) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = cores_gen) +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Projected increase in grain yield (kg/ha)",
    y = "Probability (%)",
    colour = "Genotype",
    fill   = "Genotype"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )
```
